claim: __init__.py:422 hands one preview_url per browsed clip, so a single media-browser listing fans out N deliberately-drained media sessions through api.py's one unbounded lock.
evidence: __init__.py:422 `"thumbnail": preview_url(hass, call.data["config_entry_id"], call.data["camera_index"], start),` — but preview.py:34 only returns `async_sign_path(...)`, no session; api.py:614 `async with self._lock:` serializes `iter_recording`, one session at a time; media.py:173 `if await hass.async_add_executor_job(_has_content, thumbnail): return thumbnail` caches; card.js:605 `loading="lazy"`. media_source.py never calls preview_url (only `signed_url(...)` on on-disk .jpg at lines 272/287/297), so the HA media browser is not the caller at all.
